lines.t: Verse 1
In every season, You remain the same,
A mighty fortress, strong in Your name.
When storms surround me, I will not fear,
Your love is with me, always near.
Chorus
Faithful and true, forever You reign,
Worthy of praise, forever the same.
My heart will sing, my soul will bless,
You are my joy, my righteousness.
Verse 2
You hold the heavens, the earth, and the sea,
You made the mountains, You set me free.
Your grace is endless, Your mercy new,
I lift my hands and worship You.
Chorus
Faithful and true, forever You reign,
Worthy of praise, forever the same.
My heart will sing, my soul will bless,
You are my joy, my righteousness.
Bridge
No power on earth can separate,
Your love that covers, my soul’s safe place.
I stand amazed by all You do,
My faithful King, forever true.
Final Chorus
Faithful and true, forever You reign,
Worthy of praise, forever the same.
My heart will sing, my soul will bless,
You are my joy, my righteousness.
